title: picardDirectImageDerivedTranspose
statement: Fix the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Schemes and their morphisms are as in [def-pc-scheme]; modules are sheaves of structure-sheaf modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $f:X\to S$, $k:W\to S$, $t:T\to W$ be scheme morphisms, and $L$ an $\mathcal O_X$-module. Set $X_T=X\times_S T$, $X_W=X\times_S W$, $p_t:X_T\to T$, $M=(\operatorname{tensorPullback}(X_W\to X))(L)$ and $N_t=(\operatorname{tensorPullback}(X_T\to X))(L)$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. For a derived test morphism $\xi:Lt^*(\mathcal O_W[0])\to Lt^*Rp_{W,*}(M[0])$ [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections], let $a:X_T\to X_W$ be the unique comparison with its prescribed projections. Let $B_t$ be the canonical derived base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] followed by $Rp_{t,*}$ of the canonical single-pullback comparison [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison] and the coefficient isomorphism from $a^*M$ to $N_t$ induced by the tensor-pullback adjunctions. Let $e_t:Lt^*(\mathcal O_W[0])\cong\mathcal O_T[0]$ be the single-pullback comparison followed by the structure-sheaf unit map. Define $\alpha_t(\xi):Lp_t^*(\mathcal O_T[0])\to N_t[0]$ as the inverse Hom equivalence of the pinned derived adjunction applied to $e_t^{-1}\gg\xi\gg B_t$. All maps and objects are the actual constructions used in [def-sc-picard-direct-image-unit-morphism]; no fibre-unit normalization or degree-zero homology is applied.

    (L : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S)
